nodes.label: Strict Layering Pattern
nodes.rationale: Top-to-bottom flow (View -> ViewModel -> Service Protocol -> API Client/Storage -> Decoder/Mapper -> Domain Model) so networking never lives in views and parsing is testable without UI; UI stays previewable with mocks.

nodes.label: Dependency Injection via @Entry EnvironmentValues
nodes.rationale: Services injected through SwiftUI EnvironmentValues @Entry (declared in AppDependencies.swift) so previews/tests override any service with a mock; defaults are safe no-op stubs.

nodes.label: Service Protocol Pattern (Live/Mock/Empty/Local)
nodes.rationale: Every service protocol has a production implementation, at least one mock, and an empty stub so UI is previewable and parsing testable without live network.

nodes.label: Atomic GTFS Update Flow
nodes.rationale: Download/extract/validate/index into temp and only swap current/ after success; keep old GTFS on any failure so the app never breaks on a bad update. Do not download every launch; check metadata at most once per day.

nodes.label: Forbidden Patterns (no networking in views, no god objects, no hardcoded keys)
nodes.rationale: Serious maintainable project, not a prototype: no god ContentView, no networking/business logic in views, no hardcoded keys or fake production data, keep attribution/legal screens, never imply the app is official.
nodes.norm_label: forbidden patterns (no networking in views, no god objects, no hardcoded keys)

nodes.label: File Size Rule (<300-400 lines, split large files)
nodes.norm_label: file size rule (<300-400 lines, split large files)

nodes.label: Non-Goals (no accounts/ads/subscriptions/backend, not official)
nodes.rationale: MVP deliberately excludes accounts, ads, subscriptions, a backend, full GTFS journey planning, and inventing live statuses a source does not provide; widgets must be honest about refresh limits.
